h1_emph: Auto repair in Hendersonville from people who answer the phone.
hero_lede: Auto repair in Hendersonville. Call and we will take a look.
card_about: Who you are calling, and the work we do in Hendersonville.
quote_h2: Tell us what you need done
about_p1: It was my good fortune to find Chris when he opened his business many years ago! He has been my mechanic ever since. Chris is as honest and kind as the day is long. He has kept my old car running in tip top shape for all of these years. I can't recommend him highly enough - he's just the very best!!
about_p2: I googled this place and trusted the reviews and so glad I did. Chris helped my mom and I while we were on a roadtrip, and even helped us with suggestions so that we could continue to relax and sightsee while the car was being worked on and hardly sacrifice any vacation time at all. He checked all sorts of potential pitfalls that may have occurred on the way back, too and was a lot of fun to be around.
svc_hero_h1: The auto repair work we take on

services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews_h2: What people say after we are done

reviews.author: Cathy Fickley
reviews.text: It was my good fortune to find Chris when he opened his business many years ago! He has been my mechanic ever since. Chris is as honest and kind as the day is long. He has kept my old car running in tip top shape for all of these years. I can't recommend him highly enough - he's just the very best!!

reviews.author: Bronwyn B
reviews.text: I googled this place and trusted the reviews and so glad I did. Chris helped my mom and I while we were on a roadtrip, and even helped us with suggestions so that we could continue to relax and sightsee while the car was being worked on and hardly sacrifice any vacation time at all. He checked all sorts of potential pitfalls that may have occurred on the way back, too and was a lot of fun to be around. It all added to the experience instead of took away.

reviews.author: justin narragon
reviews.text: I called yesterday and was very fortunate to have met Chris. He was very courteous and professional and didn't want to talk about money until we could find the source of the problem and that speaks volumes about his character and honesty. Anyone could just take your money and fix what you ask for but Chris makes sure that's what you need first. Went way above and beyond to earn a customer in my wife and me

reviews.author: Jaci Crossman
reviews.text: What a great experience. My car was towed here and it turned out to be just a case of having the battery cables cleaned. The owner was so kind, he took care of it quickly with a honest diagnosis and a great price! Thank you, highly recommend!

reviews.author: Bridget Mitchell
reviews.text: Stopped in for a quick inspection to renew my plates today. The owner is great. He always makes me smile. Very efficient service. I was in/out in no time. Thanks!!

reviews.author: Nerissa Efthymia
reviews.text: Truly the best in town!!! I wouldn't go anywhere else! As someone with little to no car knowledge, everyone here is super helpful and experienced and they treat you like family. I don't think I've ever waited longer than a minute or two to speak to someone about a service, even with no appointment and just showing up! Seriously, Chris and his guys are amazing!

reviews.author: Emily Bonnema
reviews.text: Laurel Park Auto was incredible to work with, they were so kind and fast! Finding them was the best decision I could have ever made and I will be using them again in the future! Thankful for them this holiday season!

reviews.author: Nikki James
reviews.text: I had an absolutely beautiful experience there. The work was quick, efficient, and done by some amazing characters who are honest and kind. Thank you!

reviews.author: Warren Seymour
reviews.text: Chris and his team do high quality work at fair prices. But most importantly I truly believe Laurel Park Auto assesses your auto with honestly and integrity. They identify the problem and no attempted up sells. I have used them three times and will go back soon.

reviews.author: Kathy Nagel
reviews.text: Laurel Park Auto is a hidden gem!! The owner, Chris is a shining star!! He explains what's wrong and how he's going to fix it - even with pictures and diagrams. He never acts rushed and is very respectful. A genuine Southern gentleman. His pricing is very fair. I intuitively trusted him beginning with the first time he helped me out in an emergency. I have been back 4 times now and I always leave thinking what an exceptional mechanic!! I have never had this level of service anywhere before - and I'm 72 years old.

reviews.author: Misty Thomas
reviews.text: Finally, a honest mechanic! I can't say enough good things. Chris is patient and gives you his honest opinion. No money grabs here.

reviews.author: Nancy Worley
reviews.text: 5 Stars to Chris at Laurel Park auto. He did a great job- no more squeeky brakes and he replaced a wheel baring. I am very happy with him and his 5 star service.

reviews.author: Jessica Zheng
reviews.text: Top one man honestly and professionally guy Chris in the town , you don’t want missed him .no hidden fee , fair fee if need work on your car .Excellent service, high performance and highly recommended. Nice guy

reviews.author: Tania Paulison
reviews.text: I was very happy with this service today. I was able to get my car inspected in about 30 seconds with no wait. Chris was very helpful and friendly. I will definitely return to this business! Loved all the antiques in the office!!

reviews.author: Sue Corey
reviews.text: Our car just quit and we had it towed to Chris. He spent days trying to diagnose the problem, he checked everything! He then suggested we take it to the dealership as he thought it was the engine and told us all he knew about engine problems with our car. He was so right! Our engine is now being replaced with a warranty that was extended by the car manufacturer because of this problem, a problem we would not have known if not for Chris. We so appreciated his time and honesty! Chris will be the only mechanic we use from now on.

reviews.author: Joel Hafer
reviews.text: Chris and company are great, and most importantly, I trust them with my car. I’ve a customer there for several years now, and I am quite pleased and satisfied with their work.

reviews.author: Siobhan Gore
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about Laurel Park Auto. Chris is always willing to help me with any of my car needs. He's very flexible and willing to work with a customer on getting the car seen in a timely manner, diagnosing the problem and repairing the car. Chris is always friendly and always takes the time to explain the work he completed.

reviews.author: Lucille Meltz
reviews.text: Chris is a honest, knowledgeable and reliable mechanic. I know I can count on him to provide quality service and answer my questions, all within fair pricing. He always goes the extra length to assure my confidence in Laurel Park Auto.

reviews.author: Samantha Elkins
reviews.text: Laurel Park Auto was amazing and efficient. I had my car overheat and they were able to get me in the next morning, and have me out the door by lunch. They even were able to provide me with a ride. The prices were great compared to the original price I had been quoted. As a single mother they were a life saver! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jodie Melton
reviews.text: I cannot recommend them enough. Chris is the BEST! He has worked on my vehicles twice now. I wouldn’t trust anyone else, he’s such a great guy and does amazing work. I’ve never met another mechanic that works as hard to fit us in and get the job done quick.

reviews.author: Joshua Bledsoe
reviews.text: I had such a positive experience. My check engine light was flashing, and I called Laurel Park Auto. They looked at my car, and fixed the spark plug and coil pack at a reasonable price. I’m thankful for honest mechanics like Chris. I definitely suggest Laurel Park auto. I will be using them for future car repair needs.

reviews.author: Alison Middleton
reviews.text: If I could give this shop 10 stars I would. Tuesday my battery died no warning. A nice couple I stop told me to call this shop and ask for Chris. What an awesome kind man. You can't teach that genuine service. He came to my home, gave me a jump, followed me to work, took my car to shop, gave me a temporary battery, and allowed me to pay him Thursday. Which is today. Then ordered me a new battery and installed it. Because my funds we low he didn't charge me extra. Now that's above and beyond service. God bless you Chris and your shop.

reviews.author: Timothy Muse
reviews.text: Excellent service, friendly and knowledgeable. Would recommend; Chris is a benefit to the local community. Thanks! Chris is the best. Installed/replaced battery; Interstate is the best too, changed oil and did some diagnostics. All in a couple of hours. I highly recommend this business which is a benefit to the community! THANKS AGAIN!

reviews.author: M Hilton Swing
reviews.text: Chris and his crew at Laurel Park Auto have been as reputable a group as your going to find in the industry, and the other reviews here are a testament to their character and reliability. I've been using Chris and Laurel Park Auto for all our automotive services in the last few years, and he stands behind his work. One of our family cars was having an issue, and Chris took a look at it and determined that it was a result of a part that was replaced in the last year....he fixed it and stood behind the work for no charge. This is the first and last stop for all your automotive needs!

reviews.author: Hollie Roma
reviews.text: Chris is a true gem! We called in the morning asking if we could get our tires balanced since our car was shaking badly on the highway. He told us to come on down and he got it all fixed up by noon! On top of what we asked, Chris went above and beyond by rotating and topping off our tires with air- even the spare! He is very friendly and pleasant to interact with as well. A really jolly, trustworthy guy. We will be coming here for all our car needs from now on, and we will recommend him to all of our local friends. Thank you, Chris!

reviews.author: Brooke Simmons
reviews.text: Chris is a super friendly guy! He was able to see me last minute and provided quality service and repair. Prices were fair and customer service exceeded expectations. Even though I was an out of town customer, I definitely recommend Laurel Park Auto shop for your car needs!

reviews.author: Teresa French
reviews.text: I have used Chris and his Laurel Park Auto team several times in the last couple of years. Chris will tell you if something needs to be repaired but will not replace something that doesn't need it. That's the way he works. I live in Laurel Park and he has offered to drive me home when I drop my car off or pick me up when it's done, which saves time and stress of trying to work out those logistics. He has always been willing to work with me on timing of services (even when I was crunched for time on my annual inspection-my fault). I am very happy to have found him, and very thankful for the service he and his team provide!

reviews.author: Nancy Irving
reviews.text: I have used Laurel Park Auto for all my automotive needs for years. Chris and his team of mechanics are superb! I always feel that the service and prices cannot be beat. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Michelle Avery
reviews.text: Chris has been taking care of my old car for 7 years now, anything from brakes, to a waterpump, to the starter. He knows I'm trying to keep it running as long as possible. He is friendly, knowledgeable, & fair. I trust him & his honesty. I took it somewhere else once, & I'll never do that again! Thanks Chris & company!

reviews.author: Suzy B
reviews.text: Chris is just the nicest mechanic I think I’ve ever met! So helpful in coordinating getting my car to his shop so he could fix it. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jeffrey Pieper
reviews.text: Went in for a NC Vehicle Inspection and found out my tires needed replacement. Chris coordinated everything for me and delivered the car with my new tires and a car wash. Easy and professional. Great neighborhood business. Nice to have them just down the street.

reviews.author: Cayce Marks
reviews.text: This place is incredible! I came in 15 minutes after calling. Chris clipped the part of the bumper hitting my tire, and checked out my diagnostics in probably 10 minutes. He was forthright, quick, and very sweet. Go here people!

reviews.author: Amanda Zinser
reviews.text: The only shop I suggest taking your vehicle to for repairs & maintenance. Chris is a great mechanic! Honest, hardworking, & has fair pricing. It’s hard to find to find a quality mechanic who will stand behind their work, why I bring my vehicle here first. Thank you for the top notch service as always!

reviews.author: Kristin P
reviews.text: Chris is super helpful! He actually answers the phone and gives all the info that you need. I told him I was going out of town this afternoon and he was able to help with my headlights the same day. We had been playing phone tag with another place for weeks after bringing our car to them for eight hours one day last month and they never got around to the repair :( Happy to find a place in town that is prompt and knows what they are doing!

reviews.author: Diane J
reviews.text: Laurel Park Auto Care helped me today when I was in a pinch. I noticed I had a flat tire as I was driving to work, so I pulled into the Shell station next to Laurel Park Auto Care and called AAA for help. After an hour when AAA hadn't replied, I walked to LP Auto Care. Even though they weren't expecting me, they not only helped me put on the spare tire, but also showed me the key tips to remember for the next time so I can do it myself. Thank you LP Auto Care! You really do care and are very knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Valerie Wright
reviews.text: Chris was awesome. I happened to be at the Gas station next door when my car died and Kim told me to go see if Chris could help so I did. He brought his equipment to me and checked to see if it was my battery or something else going on. Lucky for me it was my battery. He gave me a Jumpstart and said Merry Christmas. I will definitely be back for any car needs. Thank you again Chris!

reviews.author: Sabrina Gilbert
reviews.text: If you are looking for a home town auto shop with genuine care this is the place for you. Chris was professional, authentic, and caring. He took the time to explain things to me and gave me options. He went above and beyond my expectations. I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Dustin Melton
reviews.text: Wow. In today’s world it may seem difficult to find good people. I can say I found one. Chris at Laurel park auto is truly a superb guy. If you are looking for a mechanic, look no further. Laurel Park Auto is the place to go.

reviews.author: sheila ensley
reviews.text: I would like to say what an excellent experience I had at this shop. Chris was amazing. I don't know much about cars, but he treated me with respect and like family. I highly recommend these guys for any vehicle needs. Thanks Chris and staff.

reviews.author: Jodie Dougher
reviews.text: This place is a true gem! Chris, owner of Laurel Park Auto, is very knowledgeable, competent, and reasonably priced. I have been going there for several years and can highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rebecca Roberts
reviews.text: Excellent service. Good prices. Got my oil changed and they checked all the fluid levels and checked my tire pressure, added, if needed. Didn’t try to upsell me. Treated me with respect. Super place, I’ll be back!

reviews.author: Liz H
reviews.text: I’ve used Laurel Park Auto for the last 5 years. I got new tires last year and somewhere ran over a screw in the sidewall of one tire and a nail in another. Chris picked up my car while I was working and replaced the 2 tires and returned it back all before I got out of work. Always helpful, kind and courteous!!

reviews.author: Joseph Robustelli
reviews.text: I have been going to Laurel Park Auto for year and have always been more than satisfied with the work done. The owner is experienced and highly competent and provides expert assistance with a smile. I have recommended others who have had the same experience.

reviews.author: Scott and Nancy Kiesling
reviews.text: Highly recommend laurel park auto. It's not always easy to find honest and fair mechanics. I saw all the great reviews on here, and they hold up to the experience at hand. They were honest and fair in dealing with our car. Gave us options to choose from. We will definitely be back again.

reviews.author: Zoey N (Kinomora)
reviews.text: The owner is very kind a loves his work. He helped me determine the issue with my car and rode around the block a few time to make sure he understood. Offered great pricing and fit me into his busy holiday schedule! This is a level of quality you simply do not find everywhere these days!

reviews.author: laura s
reviews.text: I called Laurel Park Auto based on a recommendation on Nextdoor. My 2003 CRV had a driver window that would not roll up. Chris at Laurel Park Auto told me to bring it over right then and he would get the window in an up position for me until he could get the parts to fix it. Unfortunately, the window would not budge but he was able to get parts same day. He brought me home from the shop, replaced the window regulator, and then came back and picked me up when it was ready. ALL of this transpired within three hours! Chris has just earned my family's automobile repair business! Knowledgeable, friendly, and ABOVE AND BEYOND customer service!

reviews.author: Cassie Pittman
reviews.text: Chris is the best! I have taken many cars to him. He is so trustworthy , which is so rare these days!!

reviews.author: Jo Davenport
reviews.text: My interaction with Chris honestly restored some of my faith in humanity. I called with an AC emergency on a Friday morning before a holiday weekend and he offered to help. I’m thankful to have stumbled upon his shop and I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Naiad Doré
reviews.text: I called this place when my car wouldn't start and, because I was so close, he drove over to take a look. Within a few minutes Chris was able to figure out why and started my vehicle up and I was on my way. He told me that I should l have it looked at in more detail but that I should be ok until I can get it to my normal mechanic. I will definitely be giving Laurel Park Auto some of my business in the future.

reviews.author: Tina Key
reviews.text: I really appreciate the service I received at Laurel Park Auto Care. I was visiting Hendersonville when I realized that I had a screw in one of my tires. The mechanic was very helpful and professional.

reviews.author: Brian Giacomaro
reviews.text: I live within a two minute walk to Laurel Park Auto so I use them quiet frequently. I've never once had a bad experience. Ron is extremely friendly, personable, and always gets right to the point about the issue. I've never been misquoted or anything like that. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Tyra Kirby
reviews.text: Appreciate the time Chris has taken with my girls when they needed service on their cars. All around great guy, honest and trustworthy!

reviews.author: Michael Barnes
reviews.text: Great service! We got a nail in our tire and popped in here - it was taken care of quickly! Happy to recommend.

reviews.author: Devin Ross
reviews.text: Always Excellent! Good at what he does, honest and affordable. I've used Chris a number of times and the service is always great. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Lisa Sizemore
reviews.text: The Chrises are the best! Great customer service! Know what they are doing and do it well. Highly recommend them for all car care needs.

reviews.author: Mackenzie Precht
reviews.text: Chris is wonderful! Talk about someone who cares about the people who come to him and gives honest answers. Don't think twice, this is where you should take your car!

reviews.author: Zach Lantelme
reviews.text: Chris treated me real well, fixed my 4 runner up nice, and had me out of his office just hours after The car was dropped off. I will be back for my next preventative maintenance visit.

reviews.author: M. Jason Timmons
reviews.text: Nice guys, and are perfectly competent at oil changes. If you need anything else done though, beware. They did bad work for me, and when I asked for a partial refund, they hid behind paperwork, and blamed me for not continuing to trust them and pay more.

reviews.author: Faith Miller
reviews.text: Chris could not have been kinder to me this morning. He helped explain exactly what I needed fixed. I could not recommend this place more to anyone looking for an AMAZING auto shop.

reviews.author: Elliott Bennett
reviews.text: The owner is very friendly and personable. He got my car in quickly and got everything squared away. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Brittany Wright
reviews.text: Great place to get your car worked on at. Very friendly and works with you to keep it as affordable as possible. They don't try to rip people off like most auto shops would.

reviews.author: Allison Pierce
reviews.text: Thank you so much for your service!! Very friendly, good atmosphere, trustworthy and fast work. Definitely my go to people for car issues

reviews.author: Nerissa Durvas
reviews.text: If you're in need of any car repair, Laurel Park auto is your place!! They were super fast with repairs and so nice during the entire process! I won't go anywhere else!!

reviews.author: Jane Frances
reviews.text: Great friendly service, happy we stumbled upon this auto care shop! Would recommend their establishment.

reviews.author: King Hopper
reviews.text: Quick. Friendly. I thought I had a tire problem but he explained that it might be a battery in my tire. He filled my tires and sent me on my way.

reviews.author: Joel
reviews.text: Absolutely excellent service. They did amazing work on my car for a great price. I am absolutely wowed! Y'all rock!!!

reviews.author: Michelle Daw
reviews.text: Absolutely the best customer service I have ever experienced with auto repair!! Friendly responsive, door to door service. I am so relieved I found an auto shop i can trust!

reviews.author: Mike Krol
reviews.text: This place is great. Everybody needs a good mechanic. These guys are fair and affordable. I've had nothing but good experiences with them.

reviews.author: Savannah Miller
reviews.text: Very nice and friendly business super helpful and worked me in quickly when needing and urgent repair definitely will be going back to them Chris was the best.

reviews.author: Rease German
reviews.text: My car broke down right outside of this place and I am so immensely lucky that it was near this place. Everyone was as nice as can be and I will definitely be keeping in touch with this place.

reviews.author: hannah martin
reviews.text: They came out and helped me when I really needed it. On time and extremely professional, not sure what I would have done if it wasn’t for them! Thank you.

reviews.author: Brian Kaderli
reviews.text: Incredibly nice and dependable. They even offer to pick you up and drop off. Trustworthy and extremely helpful.
